map.由测得的电阻、截面积与长度计算材料电阻率（电导率倒数）。: Compute the material resistivity (the reciprocal of conductivity) from the measured resistance, cross-sectional area and length.
map.材料电阻率：测 R 与几何尺寸算 ρ，比对手册。: Material resistivity: measure R and the geometry to compute ρ, then compare against the handbook.
map.导线选型：由目标 R 与 ρ 定截面积。: Conductor selection: pick the cross-section from the target R and ρ.
map.温度影响：金属 ρ 随温升略增，注明温度。: Temperature effect: the resistivity ρ of metals rises slightly with temperature, so note the temperature.
